critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified at /app/frontend/src/components/steps/Step7.tsx:485-490 (applyCellResult). The function now ONLY mutates customInputValues for instant UI feedback, with no updateAssessment/saveDecision call. The authoritative state is the backend's $set inside /ai-assess-all-batched; the existing `await fetchDecision()` (line 534) after the loop pulls the saved state. Clean, minimal fix.

DecisionContext.updateAssessment was the underlying landmine (it reads stale React-state options inside a synchronous loop). It is still used by the per-cell save path, which is safe because there is no synchronous burst of calls there. Leaving it alone is correct; the proper fix was at the call site (Step7.runBulkAssess), not in the context.
